scope: Atomic server-ownership repository foundation, not a registered handoff API or available client workflow.
implemented: Distinct ownership repository requires actual current server owner, active generation-bound sign-in, matching password hash and MFA state. Generic platform-admin status is not an ownership override.
Recipient must be an existing server member, human, not deleted/disabled/platform-banned/server-banned. Self-transfer and malformed identity inputs are rejected.

One transaction moves server owner_id, removes prior owner-role assignments, grants exactly the one owner role to the target and persists a server_ownership_transfer audit entry. Missing/ambiguous role or any failed write rolls everything back.

Other roles, memberships, channels and history are preserved. Platform-managed hosting quota follows the existing create-server policy including its current platform-admin exemption; transfer does not silently bypass normal quota.
No runtime action or production server ownership changed. Service, cache invalidation, audit rendering, route and client workflow remain to wire before exposure.
